name: Phinehas
description: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, rose up from among the congregation, took a javelin in his hand, and thrust both of them through. And those that died in the plague were 24,000. In one day God killed 24,000, because of sin.

note.label: Why They Hated US: Walking in the Footsteps of the Persecuted

points: When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, took a javelin in his hand, went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through; so the plague was stayed from the children of Israel, and those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

note.label: Numbers 25: Baal-peor and the Zeal of Phinehas

points: A thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war, were sent with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the holy instruments and the trumpets to blow.

Israel sent Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest with ten princes, one head of a chief house from every tribe. When you send Phinehas it is a problem, because of the kind of man Phinehas was: where he showed up, the zeal of the Most High showed up with him.

Phinehas saw it, rose up from among the congregation, took a javelin, went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, and the plague was stayed from the children of Israel; those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand. So when Phinehas showed up at Gilead, everybody knew it was about to go down.

When Phinehas and the princes heard the words of the children of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh, it pleased them. Phinehas said, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the Lord.

Now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD: because they were not going off, nobody had to die that day, and coming from Phinehas that meant everything, because if it had been rebellion he would have been the one to start it.

Phinehas and the princes returned from Gilead to the land of Canaan and brought the children of Israel word again: all is good, the altar is a memorial so the generations after do not forget that our people are on that side Jordan too, and they can come in and keep the feasts and do their sacrifices with us.
Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

note.label: Joshua 24: Choose You This Day Whom Ye Will Serve

points: The ark of the covenant of God was there in those days, and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it. They asked, shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand: a direct promise of victory on the morrow.
Ezra's genealogy is traced back through Zadok and Phinehas to Eleazar the son of Aaron the chief priest, marking him a priest of the true line.

note.label: Ezra 7: Ezra The Ready Scribe Prepares His Heart

points: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, and the plague was stayed; it was counted to him for righteousness unto all generations, for he had zeal in the fear of the Most High.

note.label: Psalm 106: Israel's Rebellions and the Mercy That Gathers Them Again

points: Like as Phinees did unto Zambri: Phinees saw the sin going on with the women of Moab, and the Lord was pleased and did not destroy Israel because of that righteous anger.

note.label: The Beauty in Civility the Cost of Immorality

points: Then Phinees our father, zealous and fervent, obtained the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.
